provisions.title: Title 1: General Provisions and Administration
provisions.full_text:
The City of San Leandro is hereby divided into six Council Member Districts. Said districts shall be numbered, and the boundaries thereof shall be as indicated on that certain map entitled "City of San Leandro, Alameda County, California, Council Member District Map, 2022", a copy of which is attached hereto and incorporated herein by reference.
